newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-AUSTRALIAN P-NOTES - Tenders total A$90.0 mln.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-AUSTRALIAN P-NOTES - Tenders total A$90.0 mln.

text.p: The Australian commercial paper market saw issuers sell a total of A$90.0 million worth of promissory notes via tenders on Monday.
Property fund General Property Trust sold A$50 million of its early April-dated paper, continuing the solid run of issuance it began on Thursday last week.
Discount securities dealers said Monday's market turnover was showing an improvement over last week's levels.
Players were returning to the market as the holiday season wound down, they said.
At 2353 GMT (10.53 a.m.) March bill futures were up two points to 94.14.
